definitions.explanation: Books, especially in the context of libraries and institutional collections. A somewhat formal term for books.

examples.japanese: {図書|としょ}{館|かん}で{本|ほん}を{借|か}りた。
examples.english: I borrowed books from the library.

examples.japanese: {図書|としょ}{室|しつ}は3{階|かい}にあります。
examples.english: The library room is on the third floor.

examples.japanese: {図書|としょ}{委員|いいん}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work as a library committee member.

notes:
USAGE: {図書|としょ} is primarily used in compound words related to libraries and book collections. For 'book' in general, {本|ほん} is more common.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{図書|としょ}{館|かん} (library - public building)
・{図書|としょ}{室|しつ} (library room - in schools)
・{図書|としょ}カード (library card)
・{図書|としょ}{券|けん} (book voucher/gift certificate)
・{図書|としょ}{委員|いいん} (library committee member)
・{図書|としょ}{目録|もくろく} (book catalog)
・{参考|さんこう}{図書|としょ} (reference books)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{本|ほん} - book (everyday word)
・{書籍|しょせき} - books (formal)
・{書物|しょもつ} - books (literary/formal)
・{文献|ぶんけん} - literature, documents (academic)
